easyPrerequisites:
Spellbinder attached to a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Lands and creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands you control to become creatures with haste until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with the creature that has Spellbinder attached, triggering Spellbinder.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures and/or lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Resolve the Spellbinder trigger, casting a copy of Great Train Heist without paying its mana cost, and choosing to pay an additional {2}{R} to select its first mode, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
